prepSteps.title: Create a Connected App for Entro
prepSteps.instruction: In Salesforce Setup, create a Connected App (or External Client App) with Entro's documented OAuth scopes and record the consumer key in the operator vault.
prepSteps.evidence: Setup → App Manager lists the Entro Connected App
